title: List female superheroes published by Marvel Comics who have a speed attribu
question: List female superheroes published by Marvel Comics who have a speed attribute value lower than 80% of the average speed of all superheroes. Return their names, height, and a rank based on height in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    T1."XCL_019" AS name,
    T1."XCL_028" AS height,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
  AND T4."XCL_011" < 0.8 * (
      SELECT AVG(s."XCL_011")
      FROM hero_attribute AS s
      INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON s."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
      WHERE a."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
  )

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT 
    T1."XCL_019" AS name,
    T1."XCL_028" AS height,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1."XCL_028" DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1."XCL_021" = T2."XCL_007"
INNER JOIN publisher AS T3 ON T1."XCL_026" = T3."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T4 ON T1."XCL_018" = T4."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS T5 ON T4."XCL_010" = T5."XCL_003"
WHERE T2."XCL_008" = 'Female'
  AND T3."XCL_015" = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND T5."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
  AND T4."XCL_011" < 0.8 * (
      SELECT AVG(s."XCL_011")
      FROM hero_attribute AS s
      INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON s."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
      WHERE a."XCL_004" = 'Speed'
  )
